additional_info.body:
Hello,
Is it possible to check charger
170002444?

12:46:23 p.m. (CU Time), but she had a 0 recharge. We saw that the recharge was ended, but she saw that it was going on. In fact she saw the percentage increase. We had to perform a reboot.
Thank you in advance
software version
: v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d+APN

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0481852-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002444] Cu check CRM:03056001090
additional_info.body:
Good evening,
The customer has reached out for further clarification regarding this case.
The response provided about the charger's behavior during this charging session was not accurate.
According to the logs, the charging started around 12:40, but after 17 seconds, a remote stop command was received via OCPP and accepted.
As a result, the charging should have stopped, and the socket should have become available again.
Please need to understand why the charging session continued after it was stopped.
So please, if you need some support, involved L3 team
Thanks in advance, have a nice evening.
Best regards,
CANCELLIERI, Giuseppe (SI E EU IT)
Best regards,
CANCELLIERI, Giuseppe (SI E EU IT)
